title: One compatible host
question: Does a virus infect everyone it touches?
intervention: Turn on the Infection overlay (Lab → Observe) and watch both patches. Tap a Sprinter that is marked as infected: the inspector shows the infection and when it will burst.
predictedTradeoff: Pinphage can multiply only inside Sprinters, so the Sprinters' patch may lose members to it while the Crossfeeders, sitting in the same dose, are never infected.
confounds: Pinphage spreads and decays, so how many whole units sit beside each group changes over time; the count of cells holding at least one whole unit beside a Crossfeeder shows the virus really reached them. The two groups eat different food on different patches. One run with one seed.

all.label: At least one Sprinter was infected
A whole Pinphage unit sat beside a living Crossfeeder

completion.journalStamp: Saw Pinphage infect Sprinters, and no Crossfeeder infected beside the same dose
